On its top shelf stand five hardback books side by side with their front covers turned to face the camera; every cover is plain blank white, identical and completely empty. Shelves of books softly blurred behind. The trolley fills the lower 62% of the frame; the top 38% is an empty, plain, softly lit cream wall. Natural colours. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.

Your college email unlocks these 5 paid tools for free.

JetBrains IDEs — https://sales.jetbrains.com/hc/en-gb/articles/207241195 — All IDEs free for students
Azure for Students — https://azure.microsoft.com/en-in/free/students/ — $100 credit, no credit card
Notion Education — https://www.notion.com/help/notion-for-education — Free with a college email
Autodesk — https://www.autodesk.com/education/students — 1 year of free access
Unity Student — https://unity.com/products/unity-student — Unity Pro free for students
